route_2_sign.text: ROUTE 2: UNDER CONSTRUCTION (mostly done). North: Port City. South: Patch Town.

route_2_north_sign.text: PORT CITY AHEAD. Harbor of Root Valley. Home of Port 443, the secure dock.

route_2_worker.speaker: Lineworker
route_2_worker.text: We're laying fiber all the way to Port City. Don't trip on the cables.

route_2_worker.speaker: Lineworker
route_2_worker.text: Weird week. Half my crew got an email from someone called R. Now nobody can open their timesheets.

port_arrival.text: Salt air, gull cries, and the hum of a thousand routers. Port City.
The harbor lights flicker. Out on the water, the beacon over Port 443 burns a steady orange.

port_arrival.speaker: Dockworker
port_arrival.text: New hire? Keep your head down. Gray hoodies have been sniffing around the docks all morning.

kevin_docks.speaker: Kevin
kevin_docks.text: {player}! Did you get R's email? I replied-all with a strongly worded GIF.

kevin_docks.speaker: Kevin
kevin_docks.text: Then everyone replied-all to MY reply. My inbox is a crime scene.

kevin_docks.speaker: Kevin
kevin_docks.text: Whatever. I'm here for the Networking Cert. And to beat you. Mostly to beat you.

then.speaker: Kevin
then.text: ...The beacon just went out. I watched it. That guy didn't even look stressed.

then.speaker: Kevin
then.text: I'm not replying-all to this one. It doesn't feel funny anymore.

else.speaker: Kevin
else.text: Something's going on at Port 443. Those gray hoodies are all over Dock 443.

then.text: PORT 443 - SECURE DOCK. The sign's lights are dead. Someone has spray-painted a small "R" on it.

else.text: PORT 443 - SECURE DOCK. Guarded by Pyrewall. All traffic must present a valid certificate.

port443_breach.speaker: Zed
port443_breach.text: Name's Zed. I find the door nobody's patched, and I walk through it. Today it was this one.
Zed taps something on a phone. Out over the water, the great firewall-beacon of Pyrewall flares white...
...and goes dark. Its wings fold. The flames inside the brick go cold.
Every light in the harbor blinks out at once.

port443_breach.speaker: Zed
port443_breach.text: Port 443's closed. Permanently. Tell your manager R says hi.
Zed drops off the end of the dock into a waiting boat and is gone.

port_help_desk_locked.text: The Help Desk doors won't open. A red screen behind the glass reads: "YOUR FILES HAVE BEEN QUARANTINED. -R"
A hand-written note is taped below it: "Pop-up Help Desk in the shipping container next door. We're still open!"

popup_sign.text: POP-UP HELP DESK. Same great service. Smaller box.

popup_help_desk.speaker: Help Desk
popup_help_desk.text: Welcome to the Port City Help Desk! Well, the Port City Help Container.

popup_help_desk.speaker: Help Desk
popup_help_desk.choice: Want me to restore your Daemons?

yes.speaker: Help Desk
yes.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

yes.speaker: Help Desk
yes.text: ...All fixed. Our real building got encrypted, but our hands still work.

no.speaker: Help Desk
no.text: Ticket closed. Stay safe out there.

popup_supply.speaker: Supply Closet
popup_supply.text: Supply Closet, harbor branch! It's a shelf. In a container. Still counts.

then.speaker: Dockworker
then.text: Pyrewall's been guarding Port 443 since before I was born. Now it's just... cold brick.

then.speaker: Dockworker
then.text: Without it, anything can sail into the valley's network. That's how this R gets in everywhere.

else.speaker: Dockworker
else.text: See the orange beacon on Dock 443? That's Pyrewall. Nothing gets in without a valid certificate.

port_barista.speaker: Barista
port_barista.text: Port City runs on two things: cold brew and packet loss.

port_kid.speaker: Kid
port_kid.text: I caught a Calfiber in the tall cables by the water! It spouts light like a tiny lighthouse.

department_2_sign.text: NETWORKING DEPARTMENT. Certification trials inside. Please do not unplug anything.

basement_sign.text: EAST: THE BASEMENT. Closed for maintenance.

basement_closed.speaker: Facilities
basement_closed.text: The Basement's closed. Somebody's been messing with the old tape library down there.

basement_closed.speaker: Facilities
basement_closed.text: (That's as far as the DAEMONS demo goes for now. Thanks for playing!)

department_2_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_2_welcome.text: Welcome to Networking! The trial room is past the laser door.

department_2_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_2_welcome.text: Set the VLAN switches so only the right traffic reaches the core. The routing notes are on the shelf.

routing_notes.text: ROUTING NOTES: Trunks B and C carry staff traffic to the core.
Switch A is the guest Wi-Fi. NEVER bridge the guest network to the core. (Looking at you, Kevin.)

then.speaker: Ping
then.text: Latency's down, morale's up. Go on, {player}. The valley needs people who read the routing notes.

else.speaker: Ping
else.text: Every network's only as good as its weakest link. Let's find yours.

then.text: SWITCH A (guest): You switch it off. The port light goes dark.

else.text: SWITCH A (guest): You switch it on. The port light blinks green.

then.text: SWITCH B (trunk): You switch it off. The port light goes dark.

else.text: SWITCH B (trunk): You switch it on. The port light blinks green.

then.text: SWITCH C (trunk): You switch it off. The port light goes dark.

else.text: SWITCH C (trunk): You switch it on. The port light blinks green.
